summary.text: James Tedisco is a Republican state senator who represents New York State Senate District 44 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Tedisco, a former special education teacher, served in the State Assembly from 1983 to 2017 and has been a state senator since 2017; he is the Republican, Conservative and Vote Affordable Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: James Tedisco graduated from Bishop Gibbons High School in 1968, earned a B.A. in psychology from Union College in 1972 and an M.A. in special education from the College of Saint Rose in 1977.

His career experience includes work as athletic director, guidance counselor and varsity basketball coach at Notre Dame-Bishop Gibbons High School, as a special education teacher and varsity basketball coach at Bethlehem Central High School, and as an author.
Tedisco represented Assembly District 110 from 1983 to 2013 and Assembly District 112 from 2013 to 2017, and has served in the State Senate since 2017.

In the 2025-2026 session he is ranking member of the Senate Education Committee, the Cultural Affairs, Tourism, Parks and Recreation Committee, and the Racing, Gaming and Wagering Committee, and is also assigned to the Libraries and New York City Education committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Tedisco faces Sarah Rogerson (D / Working Families Party).
